endorsements.name: Emmanuel Lujan
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-36976
endorsements.description: Acer Global Registration Service 1.0.0.3 contains an unquoted service path vulnerability in its service configuration that allows local users to potentially execute arbitrary code. Attackers can exploit the unquoted path in C:\Program Files (x86)\Acer\Registration\ to inject malicious executables that would run with elevated LocalSystem privileges during service startup.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
